text:
maria_w: hey team — customer asked us to onboard nebula-9b (9.1B) into Private (VPC) for a HIPAA workload. They want an int8 quant path from fp16, p95 latency target ~50ms at 512 tokens, and baseline quality parity within 2% top-line on our convo-eval. can we triage? cc @sam_platform @jin_ml
ops-bot: intake created: INC-2025-0897 (assigned to eng-ml) :white_check_mark:
jin_ml: got it. can you share the model artifacts / HF repo link + tokenizer? also need representative prompts and expected max seq len (you said 512) — any long-context cases?
maria_w: here's the link to the bundle (private): s3://redwood-private-onboard/nebula-9b/nebula-9b-v1.tar.gz. tokenizer is tiktoken-compatible; no extended context beyond 512 for this customer. typical traffic: ~40 qps steady, occasional bursts to 80 qps. customer expects EOW timeline.
sam_platform: noted HIPAA -> Private is correct (no hosted). we'll need KMS + audit logging. For perf: we should plan for a dedicated pool in the VPC with autoscale burst. initial bring-up config (internal):
```
model: nebula-9b-v1
quant_recipe: gptq-8bit
batching: continuous
max_seq: 512
latency_slo_p95_ms: 50
region: us-east-1
private: true
```
this will be the baseline we test against.
emily_research: on quant: run GPTQ 8-bit with per-channel groupsize 128, then run a small eval sweep. watch out for layernorm reorder changes — some conversion scripts reorder ops which affects perf. recommended steps:
1) float32 baseline run (eval suite: llm-regress/convo-eval)
2) gptq-8bit quant + sanity prompts (100 samples)
3) run full eval (~2k samples) and compare rouge/qa/conv metrics; threshold: <2% drop on mean conv-score otherwise rollback.
example command:
```bash
python tools/quantize.py --model s3://... --method gptq --groupsize 128 --out /tmp/nebula-9b-8bit
python tools/eval.py --model /tmp/nebula-9b-8bit --suite llm-regress/convo-eval --out results/nebula-8bit.json
```
alex_k: timeline question — EOW is tight. if jin can do smoke quant + 100-sample run today we can see whether we need a deeper pass. i can prioritize it on the quant sprint if needed.
leila_sec: security checklist: ensure KMS integration for model keys, confirm customer MSP agreement, run the private deployment compliance checklist (HIPAA) and provide contact for legal review. maria, can you surface the customer BAA?
maria_w: yes — BAA in the s3 bundle at s3://redwood-private-onboard/nebula-9b/BAA.pdf. i'll also upload a 200-sample prompt set to s3://redwood-private-onboard/nebula-9b/eval_prompts/ after this thread.
jin_ml: starting smoke quant now. i'll post initial 100-sample diff + perf numbers to this thread when done. prioritizing groupsize 128 first.
maria_w: awesome — thanks. keeping customer updated: "we'll have an initial smoke report within 48h, full eval and perf numbers after quant" :thumbsup:
ops-bot: INC-2025-0897 status: triage -> in-progress
jin_ml: quick note after first smoke: quant step completed (gptq, groupsize 128) — p95 on a g4dn-like node is ~62ms at 512 (single-stream), batch=1. accuracy delta +1.8% relative to float baseline on conv-score. pushing full eval now.
maria_w: great — can we try a tiny kernel tweak or enable KV cache prefetch? sam_platform can you test a low-latency kernel flag in dev pool?
sam_platform: yes, will test kernel flag --enable-lowlatency and report back later today.
maria_w: thanks all :eyes:
